CJI Surya Kant Advocates AI and Digitalization in Judiciary

Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant has called for the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digitalization into the judicial system. He emphasized the need to balance AI-driven transformation with constitutional values, suggesting a path forward for the modernization of justice delivery.
